content: {"summary":"At 10:15 UTC on 8 August 2026 the orders‑api pods reported pg pool exhaustion (WARN pg pool in use 16 of 25, waiting requests 1 and ERROR ORD‑5003 no pool connection became free). Evidence shows the pg pool maxes at 25 connections with a default idle timeout of 10 seconds, causing connections to be closed between traffic bursts and new connections to require a DNS lookup of orders‑db‑01.prod.internal. The pod’s resolver config (ndots 5) makes each lookup issue up to eight UDP queries; occasional lost replies trigger a 5‑second resolver timeout and retries, saturating libuv’s four‑thread worker pool and delaying new connections. This DNS‑induced delay explains the sudden pool exhaustion despite ample database slots. The incident write‑up’s claim of a slow DB query is not supported by the logs.","likely_cause":"DNS resolver delays (lost UDP replies and ndots‑5 configuration) causing libuv thread‑pool saturation and delayed pg connection establishment, leading to pg pool exhaustion","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"Orders‑api pods showed high pg pool usage and waiting requests at 10:15","evidence_ids":["log:7533","log:7540"],"quote":"pg pool in use 16 of 25, waiting requests 1"},{"text":"pg Pool max is 25 per pod with idleTimeoutMillis default 10 seconds","evidence_ids":["RB-021#1"],"quote":"idleTimeoutMillis at its default, 10 seconds"},{"text":"DNS lookups can stall 5 seconds when a UDP reply is lost, saturating libuv threads","evidence_ids":["RB-021#4","RB-021#5"],"quote":"When a reply is missing, the resolver waits out its 5 s timeout"},{"text":"Changing ndots to 2 reduced lookup queries and eliminated 5‑second outliers","evidence_ids":["RB-021#6"],"quote":"ndots:2, a two-dot name is asked as written first"},{"text":"Incident write‑up attributes cause to a slow DB query, but no supporting evidence is present","evidence_ids":["INC-0182#0"],"quote":"What was holding the connections? A slow query on orders-db"}],"next_checks":["Monitor DNS query loss rates during traffic bursts","Measure libuv thread‑pool utilization in orders‑api pods","Consider increasing UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE or using IP addresses for DB host","Verify idleTimeoutMillis setting to avoid premature connection closure","Check orders‑db logs for any slow queries during the incident window"]}
